boundary.resolution: GEO is one captured addressed-record job, distinct from GTE and GPU. Installed resources, three coordinate/operation paths, memory ownership and no direct raster output are independently source/semantic checked (GCR/GXF/GSA/GOV).

registers.resolution: All16 bank words plus separate FAULT_ACK include exact address/access/reset/bits/raw readback, complete command encodings, pulse and sticky-state effects. Independent paired-source check passes; internal save state is not exposed as extra cartridge words.

datapath.resolution: All XFORM2/SAT2/OVERLAP layouts, byte/index/stride units, fixed and binary32 formats, arithmetic/rounding/saturation, ordering/filtering/ties, contact selection and output/summary semantics are covered. Three GOV audit findings and one extraction shorthand error were corrected and rechecked.

visibility.resolution: Captured configuration versus live payload, record progress, ordered memory effects, BUSY rewrites, destructive rejection, immediate OVERLAP summary initialization including COUNT0, partial outputs and non-atomic summaries are independently source-checked.

timing.resolution: Installed33,868,800 cycles/s and16,384,000 record-credit units/s, exact accrual/threshold formula, delayed/coalesced service, idle credit and per-record versus per-vertex/pair distinction are covered. Twelve paired current-owner replay records agree; no invented electrical/byte-bandwidth rating.

interrupts.resolution: DONE bit3 and ERROR bit4, distinct status encodings, central pending/mask/ACK versus local FAULT_ACK, coalescence and accepted-interrupt HALT event latch are source-checked. Ordinary example observes DONE5/ERROR1 without clearing unrelated pending.

faults.resolution: All defined codes and actual command-specific emitted conditions/precedence, rejection versus execution error, ABORT, sticky first fault, local recovery, partial progress/output and mapped access faults are source-checked. Unestablished malformed/nonfinite clipping safety, huge-counter and arbitrary-alias guarantees are not invented.

reset.resolution: Unit reset cancels service/job/credit and clears17 visible words, preserves installed timing and does not itself reset central IRQ pending. No register reset command is invented; ABORT and local acknowledgement remain distinct.

programming.resolution: Short transform/SAT sequences and an authored sprite/hull example accompany command records, results, timing and actual scene illustrations.
